script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 增量更新：新增 cxmooc-tools 三个脚本 + 更新工具页与资源卡片
set -u
echo "== 解包增量包 =="
rm -rf /tmp/xm-cx-upd && mkdir -p /tmp/xm-cx-upd
echo '' | base64 -d > /tmp/xm-cx-upd/p.tgz
tar -xzf /tmp/xm-cx-upd/p.tgz -C /tmp/xm-cx-upd
echo "== 覆盖到站点 =="
sudo cp -r /tmp/xm-cx-upd/tools /var/www/xinmo-site/
sudo cp /tmp/xm-cx-upd/assets/js/resources.js /var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/resources.js
sudo chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/xinmo-site/tools/chaoxing-speed 2>/dev/null || true
echo "== 校验 =="
ls -l /var/www/xinmo-site/tools/chaoxing-speed/
echo "-- 脚本版本 --"
grep -h '@version' /var/www/xinmo-site/tools/chaoxing-speed/cxmooc-tools.user.js | head -1
grep -c 'cxmooc-tools' /var/www/xinmo-site/tools/chaoxing-speed/index.html
echo "-- 资源卡片 --"
grep -c 'cxmooc-tools' /var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/resources.js
echo "== DONE =="
